newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 27.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* The volatile Dow Jones Industrial Average ended 36 points lower on Thursday at 7654.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange blue-chip index ended down 3.22 points at 1,066.74.
* Analysts said the market expected to remain lacklustre with mild selling by foreigners to continue
* Focus to be on DRB-Hicom group firms Diversified Resources Bhd, Gadek and Gadek Capital which announced sharp rise in profit on Thursday.
* MBf Holdings and MBf Capital may remain in focus after announcing plan to acquire a bank in Thailand.
* Analysts say there could be a technical rebound if the blue-chip index holds in the 1,040/1,050 range, a strong support level.
